svg.title: Premium event entrance (concept)
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: A freestanding arch for the Soor Sadan forecourt: a white header
beam that lets the logo sit on its own ground, Plum pylons wrapped
in the ornamental border, and an orange base line that points
CONCEPTUAL VISUALISATION · NOT A BUILT INSTALLATION
Concept rendered over the venue photograph from the official STFE 2027 brochure. Proportions indicative; not a built structure.
